name: @nexus/sync-port
description: The one real CryptoPort: WebCrypto for SHA-256, HMAC, HKDF and X25519; hash-wasm's WASM Argon2id; @noble/ciphers for XChaCha20-Poly1305, the one primitive WebCrypto does not have. Separate from @nexus/sync-crypto so that package keeps its zero-runtime-dependency claim honestly, and so 'what crypto does sync use' is answered by reading one file.
